title: perf(mobile): ThreadFeed compiles with the React Compiler
body:
`ThreadFeed.tsx` and `use-thread-selection.ts` were still in `KNOWN_BAILOUTS`, so the compiler skipped both and the feed kept 40 manual `useMemo`/`useCallback`s.

**ThreadFeed**

- Every "ref read during render" came from `props.listRef` inside render props. The component now destructures `listRef` and the two callbacks its handlers call.
- The attachment opener threw inside `try`/`finally`. It now reads the asset command's `AsyncResult`, settles the download with `settlePromise`, and clears `opening` in one `finish` path. Aborts still skip the alert.
- With the file compiling, the component's manual `useMemo`/`useCallback` wrappers are removed. The bodies are unchanged.

**use-thread-selection**

- The last complete route params lived in a ref read during render, used when a closing sheet drops the params. They are now previous-value state that is set during render.
- The pending creation is compared by message and outcome, not identity. `pendingCreation` is rebuilt every render, so an identity check would have set state on every render once the hook compiled.

Both files leave `KNOWN_BAILOUTS`, with no layout-effect ref syncs added. `ThreadFeed`'s render-time clock (`isFreshTimestamp`) lives in a module function called from `renderItem`, which runs per row, so it isn't frozen in a cache.

## Renders on the device

Pixel 9 API 36 emulator, median of 3 runs, same base (layer 10) and device. As with the earlier compile layers, compiling these files does not change renders per commit:

| Scenario | Renders per commit before | After | Commits (before / after) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| The open thread streams | 40 | 41 | 36 / 42 |
| Typing in the composer | 33 | 36 | 28 / 32 |
| Another thread streams while on a different thread | 89 (layer 9) | 46 | — / 8 |

The remaining stream renders are the list cells (`Container2`) and markdown hosts, which LegendList drives.

On Android I opened a thread, scrolled up through a long reply, used jump-to-end, and opened the Git sheet.

Claude Opus 5.5 via Claude Code.
